13 distinct native sessions: 8 analysis/development and 5 materials. Three root sidebar identities have matching raw index rows; child sidebar and all Comate identity fields remain explicitly unverified. Initial mixed overview excluded.
All 13 native exports and all 13 Markdown files exist; independently recomputed SHA-256 values match export_sha256 and markdown_sha256.

28 local requirement IDs and 19 planned cases are not equated to official F-points. Old HAP/device reuse, WFP transport rather than guest LinkDown, zero-arrival interpretation, retained failures/diagnostic gaps and untested conditions are disclosed.
Baseline and observed technical/tool sources are listed with evidence references; empty extra_sources/source_guard declarations remain pending. No full source-compliance audit is claimed.

Four current taskbook project/common hashes and three official template hashes independently match the recorded values; team/task input hashes match; no spec/history directory. All 8 current-stage configuration snapshot hashes match. The parent-workspace Git commit is not represented as a task feature commit or as proof of unrecorded historical taskbooks.

4175 unique manifest paths; 84 exclusions = 64 emulator runtime + 6 pyc + 14 mixed initialization raw snapshots. Exclusion/manifest intersection is empty, no entry/AppScope exclusions, no generated draft paths included. No other .comate files exist in the manifest. Completeness is explicitly limited to the manifest projection, not an unfiltered local-directory archive. The derived draft remains outside project to prevent self-reference.

Documents consistently report patch --check/apply exit 0, 4175 comparisons, zero mismatch/extra/source-change and preserved whitespace warnings. This reviewer read that audit and checked the projection metadata, but did not rerun patch application or full 4175-file comparison.

JSON parses and has the five official per-task fields; paths are the expected package-relative forward-slash paths, with build/index file paths. submitted is a prepared task-list entry, not proof of upload or of completed team freeze. Team-wide all-task assembly remains 3-package work.

Current Windows OpenAI.Codex 26.1013.4894.0 is supported by the collected Get-AppxPackage record; CLI 0.163.0-alpha.10.2 stays separate. Historical GUI/Mac/Comate-extension evidence is not inferred. Pattern scan records two encrypted_content false positives and no unresolved credential hits within that limited scan; it is not a full secrets or source-compliance audit.
